ns2:course.label: Senior Thesis
ns2:course.description: Individual research for majors in humanities leading to the completion of a thesis. 0 to 4 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: Senior standing, a declared option in humanities major, and consent of advisor.
